svg.aria-label: Autonomous Browser Agent — LLM plan, schema gate, deterministic execution
svg.title: Autonomous Browser Agent — LLM plan, schema gate, deterministic execution
svg.desc: A page snapshot and section catalog feed an LLM, which returns a strict JSON plan. The plan passes through a schema gate, assertPlan. A validated plan runs as a deterministic Playwright sequence of expand, fill, select, click and done actions using label-based selectors. A malformed plan or unknown action is rejected and throws, never reaching the browser.
